# What the builders and the checks run, pinned with hashes, every dependency
# included. Nothing here is copied into the tree. Install into a virtual
# environment, then fetch the browser the images are drawn with:
#   python3 -m venv .venv
#   .venv/bin/pip install --require-hashes -r requirements.txt
#   .venv/bin/python -m playwright install chromium
# Python 3.15 (.python-version).
#
# The direct pins; every other line is what they need:
# - fonttools, uharfbuzz: the lettering and every word in an image, shaped
#   with HarfBuzz and outlined with fontTools from the pinned fonts
#   (tools/kleidos_brand/lettering.py).
# - playwright, pillow: drawing, Chromium through Playwright, then Pillow
#   from pixels alone (tools/kleidos_brand/raster.py, png.py), at the versions
#   the pictures recorded in exports.json were drawn with, so they can be
#   reproduced.
# - pytest, pytest-cov: the checks, and their coverage in CI for SonarQube
#   Cloud (.coveragerc).
# - reuse, charset-normalizer: the licensing check, and the one module it
#   needs to detect a file's encoding.
# - pyyaml: the quality kit's hooks read workflows and dependabot.yml with
#   it (kleidos-kit, from the repository's environment); the kit's pin.
# - uv: the KiCad kit's CI job installs the Python .python-version names
#   inside KiCad's container with it, from its hashed lines below
#   (.github/workflows/check.yml).
# - pypdf: the KiCad kit's helper (kicad/kleidos_kicad.py) reads and rewrites
#   the PDF exports of boards and the meter with it, the version they pin;
#   installed here so mypy checks the helper against pypdf's own types.
#
# Compiled for every platform and Python 3.15 or newer from the direct pins
# at the versions this file holds, with
#   grep -E '^(fonttools|uharfbuzz|playwright|pillow|pytest|pytest-cov|reuse|charset-normalizer|pyyaml|uv|pypdf)==' \
#     requirements.txt | cut -d' ' -f1 |
#     uv pip compile --universal --generate-hashes --no-header --no-annotate \
#       --python-version 3.15 - > new.txt
# and this header put back on top; never edit the hashes by hand. Dependabot
# bumps every line and its hashes; a bump that needs a new dependency fails
# the install in CI until the file is compiled again.
